narrative: New Spaces this week (6,081, +2.1%) tilt toward interactive, human-facing builds: chat and assistants remain the largest named use case at 904, while voice and audio grew fastest among named use cases at 361 (+11.1%). Verticals point at consumer, media and research audiences, with healthcare the fastest-moving share (5.4%, +0.7 points). Agentic and vision-language framings each picked up ground among techniques, document AI moved the other way (−7.6%), and model publishing overall was slightly lower (−1.9%) even as downloads and likes climbed.
